summary.text: Trish Schreiber is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election against independent Shayne Morgan; there is no incumbent in the race.

paragraphs.text: Trish Schreiber advanced from the Republican primary for Montana House of Representatives District 76 on June 2, 2026.
